title: Planning Your Roofing Enquiry: What to Prepare
excerpt: A practical checklist to help you discuss your roofing requirements with the Roofseal team.

sections.heading: Start with the project
paragraphs: Prepare the project location, building use and approximate roof area. If you have drawings, a roof plan or photographs, keep them ready for discussion so the team can understand the scope of your enquiry.

sections.heading: Explain your priorities
paragraphs: Tell the team whether you are planning a new building, replacing an existing roof or comparing product options. Note your priorities, such as appearance, insulation, maintenance or coordination with other building components.

sections.heading: Consider the complete system
paragraphs: A roofing enquiry may involve more than the roof covering. Discuss insulation, gutters, flashing, skylights, structural components and fasteners where they are relevant. Final selections and specifications should be reviewed for the project rather than assumed from a photograph.

sections.heading: Send a clear enquiry
paragraphs: Use the quote list to collect the products you would like to discuss, then include your contact and project details. Submitting an enquiry starts a discussion; it does not confirm a price, order or installation date.

title: A Closer Look at Roofseal’s Product Divisions
excerpt: An introduction to the Metal Roofing and Doors & Frames divisions and the products available for discussion.

sections.heading: Two divisions, a practical product range
paragraphs: Roofseal’s product range is organised into Metal Roofing and Doors & Frames. These divisions help clients explore the building products relevant to their projects and prepare more focused enquiries.

sections.heading: Metal Roofing Division
paragraphs: The Metal Roofing Division brings together roof coverings, insulation, gutter and roof components, skylights and structural products. Product selection depends on the building and project requirements.

sections.heading: Doors & Frames Division
paragraphs: The Doors & Frames Division includes metal door frames and fire-rated doors. Discuss the required dimensions, finishes, hardware and applicable documentation with the team before making a final selection.

sections.heading: Explore and enquire
paragraphs: Browse the division pages, review the available product information and add relevant products to your quote list. This draft introduces the existing divisions; it does not announce a new launch or a change in product certification.

title: Preparing for a Roofing Product Consultation
excerpt: A preparation guide for a future product discussion. No event date or registration has been announced.

sections.heading: Plan the discussion
paragraphs: Prepare a short description of your project and the product questions you would like to discuss. Bring available drawings, approximate quantities and any requirements supplied by your project team.

sections.heading: List the decisions to make
paragraphs: Your discussion might cover roof profiles, insulation, rainwater goods, door frames or product documentation. Identify which decisions are still open and which specifications have already been confirmed by your consultant or contractor.

sections.heading: Confirm arrangements directly
paragraphs: Contact Roofseal to discuss the availability and format of a product consultation. This is draft planning content for client review. It is not an invitation to a scheduled event, and it does not confirm a date, venue, attendance fee or registration arrangement.
